title: Prompts Chat is the World's Biggest Free AI Prompt Library with over 50k+ Prompts for various tasks
description:
Someone just built the world's biggest prompt library.

They made it completely free and open source.

It's called prompts.chat.

It has over ten thousand prompts for writing, coding, images, video, and research.

Plus ready made skills and workflows for pretty much any task you can think of.

That covers writers, developers, designers, and researchers all in one single place.

And the best part is you can plug the whole library straight into your Claude Code as an MCP server.

So your agent automatically picks the best prompt for whatever task you're working on.

You never have to copy paste anything again.

Think of it like giving your agent its own personal library card, it grabs exactly what it needs, right when it needs it.

No more digging through old notes or bookmarked tweets trying to remember which prompt actually worked last time.

Everything just lives in one place, ready whenever your agent needs it.

Whether you're writing a blog post, debugging code, or generating an image, there's already a tested prompt waiting for you.
